steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: WARNING — Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before servicing.

steps.title: Live valve test failed
steps.body: This procedure continues after Quick Service Cycle / load test did not activate the suspect valve.
steps.sourceExcerpt: This procedure continues after Quick Service Cycle / load test did not activate the suspect valve.

steps.title: Disconnect J8 at ACU
steps.body: Remove top panel. Disconnect connector J8. Verify harness continuity to valve coils.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove top panel. Disconnect connector J8. Verify harness continuity to valve coils.

steps.title: Inlet valve coil resistance
steps.body: Measure coil resistance: C1 J8-1&2, C2 J8-1&3, Hot J8-1&5. Expected 1.1–1.35 kΩ each.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Measure coil resistance: C1 J8-1&2, C2 J8-1&3, Hot J8-1&5. Expected 1.1–1.35 kΩ each.

steps.title: Reconnect J8
steps.body: Reconnect J8 to ACU. Restore power for live activation test via QSC/load test.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Reconnect J8 to ACU. Restore power for live activation test via QSC/load test.

steps.title: Valve energizes with line voltage
steps.body: During load test or component activation, does the suspect valve receive line voltage and open?
steps.sourceExcerpt: During load test or component activation, does the suspect valve receive line voltage and open?

branches.label: No line voltage at valve
branches.oemOutcome: Replace ACU — no drive voltage to valve.

steps.title: Replace valve assembly
steps.oemOutcome: Replace inlet valve assembly when coil open or out of range.

steps.title: Valve verified
steps.oemOutcome: Valve operates — reassemble and verify with Quick Service Cycle.

steps.title: Replace ACU
steps.oemOutcome: Replace ACU when ohms good but no activation voltage.
